lastCompletedStory.title: WARNING: `${{ github.ref_name }}` is interpolated directly into a `run:` shell…

nextStoryContext: release.yml's `gh release create`/`--title` `run:` block no longer interpolates `${{ github.ref_name }}` directly; the raw tag value is bound once to `env: TAG: ${{ github.ref_name }}` and referenced as the double-quoted `"$TAG"` shell variable at both use sites (lines 34 and 40 in the pre-fix file), per GitHub's security-hardening guide's intermediate-environment-variable pattern (confirmed live against the current docs in officialDocsValidated below). This is the same env-var-indirection idiom already used elsewhere in the workflow for `GH_TOKEN`. `scripts/check-ci-parity.ts`'s `CI_YML_PATH` constant only ever reads `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (see patterns.md US-003/CAM-460 bullet), so this change to the sibling `release.yml` is invisible to that gate by construction and needed no parity-check update. Full `bun run check:all` is green: 5992 pass / 0 fail, typecheck clean, lint/file-size/debt-markers/coverage/dead-code/dup/ci-parity/agents-md/test-sleeps/skip-ratchet all ok; no vendor/templates files touched.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed current guidance: bind untrusted expression (github.ref_name) to an env: var, reference it double-quoted ($VAR) in run: -- exactly the pattern applied.
